title: Extending a Unary Tape
statement: For every $q\in\mathbb{N}$, changing the tape contents $\tau_q$ by writing $1$ at cell $q$ gives $\tau_{q+1}$.
replaced: For every $q \in \mathbb{N}$, writing the symbol $1$ into cell $q$ of the tape contents $\tau_q$ yields $\tau_{q+1}$, where $\tau_q \colon \mathbb{Z} \to \{0,1,\sqcup\}$ holds $1$ on cells $0,\dots,q-1$ and the blank $\sqcup$ elsewhere.
